title: Repair a broken importer
description: Repair read_scores(path). Each UTF-8 line is name,score with no header or quoted commas. Strip both fields. Keep nonempty names with integer scores 0–100 inclusive; skip malformed rows. Return [records,rejected_line_numbers] in input order, using 1-based lines. Empty file returns [[],[]]; let FileNotFoundError propagate. Include programmer/date/purpose/version comments, meaningful names, and a short diagnosis of syntax, runtime and logic bugs. Behaviour is checked automatically; style is reviewed separately.
hints: Separate validation, state changes and output.
Try an empty case, an exact boundary and repeated operations.
rubric: Explain the missing colon, unsafe split/conversion and incorrect range condition.
Show normal, abnormal and boundary test cases.
Review naming, indentation and header/version comments.
